items.title: Swarms: several agents on one job
items.text: Ask for "a swarm" or "3 agents" and several agents work at once, each in a chat of its own, across your computers and models. In a split each takes a part of the job; in a race, models answer the same question and the best answer wins.

items.title: Projects keep related chats together
items.text: A project holds instructions, files, a folder, a default profile and model, and a memory of its own. Its chats follow its instructions, search its files, and remember what they learn for the project's other chats, not your others.

items.title: gpt-oss and Qwen 3.6 in the catalog
items.text: OpenAI's gpt-oss 20B and 120B and Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B are in the model catalog. They're mixtures of experts, so how well they fit and how fast they run is estimated from the part each word uses. Effort sets how long gpt-oss thinks.

items.title: Keep a model running
items.text: Pin a chat model as Always running and it loads when Toskar starts, comes back if it stops, and isn't unloaded when idle. With paired computers, a model that doesn't fit beside it runs on another computer; otherwise an Admin can stop the pinned one for that answer.

items.title: Honest answers offline, and links that open
items.text: Offline, a question that needs the internet says this computer isn't connected instead of making up an answer. Turn on Check links in answers, and Toskar asks each linked site whether its page opens and crosses out the links that don't.

items.title: Changes ask first again
items.text: In the built-in profiles, writing files, running terminal commands, and Git add and commit ask first, and Allow for session still covers the rest of a chat. Git push asks every time, since it sends your code off the computer.
